<h1>Prints</h1>
<p class="sg-lede">Woodcut, linocut and engraving prints traced from the woodcuts mood board: pomegranates, oak leaves and acorns, pinecones, hanging fruit, round flowers, a lily, wildflowers, tulips, a flowering branch, a mountain range with and without a gold sun, and a flock of swallows. Each as an SVG and a transparent 1000px PNG.</p>
<dl class="sg-facts"><dt>Use for</dt><dd>Printed texture at size: covers, grounds under a transparency, the podcast flock.</dd><dt>Colour</dt><dd>As printed: never retint them to the illustration inks. Often used under a transparency; keep it subtle. The gold sun and the pale-yellow branch are kept by choice.</dd><dt>Grounds</dt><dd>White, Paper, Sunlight</dd><dt>Registers</dt><dd>Conversation, Gathering</dd><dt>Formats</dt><dd>SVG and PNG</dd><dt>Rights</dt><dd>Not cleared. Traced or cut from mood board images whose rights are not cleared: fine for mockups and drafts; redraw, re-source or clear before anything goes public.</dd></dl>
</header>
